english.title: Failing to comply with enforcement notice under section 18A - Aviation Security Act 1982
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with an enforcement notice served on you under section 18A of the Aviation Security Act 1982 by an authorised person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 18C(1) of the Aviation Security Act 1982.

english.notes: Section 18C(2) of the Aviation Security Act 1982 provides that where a person convicted of this offence, then, if without reasonable excuse the failure in respect of which he was convicted is continued after the conviction, he commits another offence. The penalty on summary conviction is a £100 fine for each day on which the failure continues.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: A fine.

Where a person convicted of this offence continues without reasonable excuse the failure in respect of which he was convicted after the conviction, he commits another offence, section 18C(2) of the Aviation Security Act 1982.
SUMMARY: A £100 fine for each day on which the failure continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
